summary: Frontend UI verification for FINORA Portfolio account-separation filter + EntityManager online price refresh. All specified requirements pass: account selector filters KPIs/charts/holdings-table; group headers show count + total valuation; assets-refresh-prices button works and reloads table.

verification_details.login_and_consent: client@finora.co.jp login successful; no consent modal appeared on this run (already accepted previously).
verification_details.account_selector: data-testid=portfolio-account-select is a native <select> with 6 options in exact required order: 全口座 (value=''), bitFlyer (JPY), Interactive Brokers (USD), SBI証券 (JPY), 三菱UFJ銀行 (JPY), 口座未設定 (value='none').
verification_details.filter_SBI証券: pf-total_assets decreased to ¥3,610万, holdings-table rows = 4 — filter working.
verification_details.filter_口座未設定: pf-total_assets = ¥1.04億, holdings-table rows = 2 containing 港区南青山マンション and 終身保険(解約返戻金) — matches spec.
verification_details.restore_all_accounts: Switching back to 全口座 restored 12 rows and ¥2.11億.
verification_details.assets_refresh_prices_button: data-testid=assets-refresh-prices present in toolbar. Click triggers refresh loop; portfolio KPI updated from ¥2.11億→¥2.06億 and holdings-table current prices/values changed; entry table reloaded after completion.
verification_details.assets_add_to_links: 5 assets-add-to-<key> links (one per group) present, matching account count.

observations_for_main_agent: Success toast after 現在価格を更新 was not captured by generic selectors within the polling window. Refresh action itself works end-to-end (values reload, KPIs update). Main agent may want to confirm the toast component/duration if the count feedback is important to users.

Some /api/quote responses appear to return non-JPY-normalized values (e.g. BTC current_price became 30, US Treasury 2034 became 38) which produce large negative pl_jpy after refresh. This is upstream quote data (per request note: 'some tickers may fail is acceptable'), not a frontend wiring issue, but user-visible P&L can look alarming. Consider currency-normalization or minimum-sanity guard in backend/quote.py.
critical_code_review_comments: Consider validating quote result plausibility (e.g., reject prices >10x or <0.1x last known price) before persisting in PUT /api/data/assets/{id} to prevent obviously-wrong tickers from destroying displayed P&L.
seed_data_creation: None. Demo assets untouched (only current_price/price_date may have been updated by refresh — expected per feature).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Portfolio account filter and EntityManager price refresh are functioning correctly end-to-end. Note: portfolio-account-select is a native <select>, use select_option() with value (empty string for 全口座, 'none' for 口座未設定, UUID for real accounts). Group headers text is concatenated as '<name> (n)¥amount ＋ 新規登録' — no space before ¥.
